name: Resonance Gardens
description: The Resonance Gardens are Ka Vethan’s harmonic green spaces, shaped by void‑arcane resonance and Luclinite horticulture. Crystal‑rooted flora, resonance pools, void‑aligned arboretums, and meditative pathways create an environment of balance and civic tranquility. Akhevan caretakers maintain the gardens, ensuring environmental harmony and ritual alignment.
